definitions.explanation: A major Japanese maker of whisky, beer and soft drinks, founded in Osaka in 1899. Its whiskies (Yamazaki, Hibiki, Kakubin) helped make Japanese whisky known worldwide.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Suntory's whisky and its highball (⟦ハイボール→ハイボール：27604_haibooru⟧, whisky with soda) campaigns shaped how Japanese people drink whisky: often diluted, with meals, in an izakaya. Its products also include beer (ザ・⟦プレミアム→プレミアム：11290_puremiamu⟧・モルツ), canned chuhai and bottled tea and water, so the name appears on drinks everywhere.
